**Objective:** Analyze changes in Köppen–Trewartha climate classifications among the REF, CSN, and RCI climate intervals. This notebook quantifies how much global land area changes climate group or type, identifies the most important transitions, summarizes net gains and losses by classification, and saves a unified transition dataset for geographic mapping in the final stage of the workflow.

## Transition Comparisons

Three pairwise comparisons are used to separate historical, recent, and long-term classification change:

- **REF → CSN** — change from the 1961–1990 WMO Climatological Reference Period to the 1991–2020 WMO Climatological Standard Normals.
- **CSN → RCI** — change from the 1991–2020 standard normal to the 2021–2025 Recent Climate Interval.
- **REF → RCI** — the full contrast between the reference period and the recent interval.

Transition calculations use land-area weighting based on the ERA5 grid-cell area multiplied by the fractional land-sea mask.

## Climate Periods

```{r}
#| label: climate-periods

source("R/climate-periods.R")

climate_periods |>
  transmute(
    `Period` = period_name,
    `Short Label` = period_label,
    `Abbreviation` = period_abbr,
    `Years` = sprintf("%d–%d", start_year, end_year)
  ) |>
  gt()

transition_comparisons <- tribble(
  ~comparison_id, ~comparison_label, ~from_period_id, ~to_period_id,
  "ref_csn", "REF → CSN", "reference_period", "standard_normal",
  "csn_rci", "CSN → RCI", "standard_normal", "recent_interval",
  "ref_rci", "REF → RCI", "reference_period", "recent_interval"
)

comparison_levels <- transition_comparisons$comparison_label

period_palette <- setNames(
  viridisLite::viridis(
    nrow(climate_periods),
    option = "D",
    begin = 0.25,
    end = 0.80
  ),
  climate_periods$period_abbr
)

```

## Functions

```{r}
#| label: functions

# creates the three grid-cell transition datasets
fn_build_transition <- function(
  classification_df,
  comparison_row
) {
  from_id <- comparison_row$from_period_id[[1]]
  to_id <- comparison_row$to_period_id[[1]]

  from_df <- classification_df |>
    filter(period_id == from_id) |>
    transmute(
      lon,
      lat,
      area,
      lsm,
      from_grp = as.character(grp),
      from_ktc = as.character(ktc)
    )

  to_df <- classification_df |>
    filter(period_id == to_id) |>
    transmute(
      lon,
      lat,
      to_area = area,
      to_lsm = lsm,
      to_grp = as.character(grp),
      to_ktc = as.character(ktc)
    )

  transition_df <- from_df |>
    inner_join(
      to_df,
      by = c("lon", "lat")
    )

  if (
    any(
      abs(transition_df$area - transition_df$to_area) > 1e-8,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) ||
      any(
        abs(transition_df$lsm - transition_df$to_lsm) > 1e-8,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  ) {
    stop(
      "Grid-cell area or land-sea mask differs between ",
      comparison_row$comparison_label[[1]],
      " classification datasets."
    )
  }

  transition_df |>
    transmute(
      comparison_id = comparison_row$comparison_id[[1]],
      comparison_label = comparison_row$comparison_label[[1]],
      from_period_id = from_id,
      to_period_id = to_id,
      lon,
      lat,
      area,
      lsm,
      land_area = area * lsm,
      from_grp,
      to_grp,
      from_ktc,
      to_ktc,
      group_changed = from_grp != to_grp,
      type_changed = from_ktc != to_ktc
    ) |>
    filter(
      lsm > 0,
      is.finite(land_area),
      land_area > 0,
      !is.na(from_grp),
      !is.na(to_grp),
      !is.na(from_ktc),
      !is.na(to_ktc)
    )
}

# overall classification change summary
fn_change_overview <- function(transitions_df) {
  transitions_df |>
    group_by(
      comparison_id,
      comparison_label
    ) |>
    summarise(
      total_land_area = sum(land_area, na.rm = TRUE),
      group_changed_area = sum(
        land_area[group_changed],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      type_changed_area = sum(
        land_area[type_changed],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      group_changed_pct = group_changed_area / total_land_area,
      type_changed_pct = type_changed_area / total_land_area,
      comparison_label = factor(
        comparison_label,
        levels = comparison_levels
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(comparison_label)
}

# group/type transition summaries
fn_transition_summary <- function(
  transitions_df,
  from_variable,
  to_variable
) {
  transitions_df |>
    transmute(
      comparison_id,
      comparison_label,
      from_class = .data[[from_variable]],
      to_class = .data[[to_variable]],
      land_area
    ) |>
    group_by(
      comparison_id,
      comparison_label,
      from_class,
      to_class
    ) |>
    summarise(
      mkm = sum(land_area, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    group_by(
      comparison_id,
      comparison_label
    ) |>
    mutate(
      pct = mkm / sum(mkm)
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      changed = from_class != to_class,
      comparison_label = factor(
        comparison_label,
        levels = comparison_levels
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(
      comparison_label,
      desc(mkm)
    )
}

# group/type gains, losses, and net change
fn_net_change <- function(
  transition_summary,
  class_levels
) {
  from_summary <- transition_summary |>
    group_by(
      comparison_id,
      comparison_label,
      class = from_class
    ) |>
    summarise(
      from_mkm = sum(mkm),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  to_summary <- transition_summary |>
    group_by(
      comparison_id,
      comparison_label,
      class = to_class
    ) |>
    summarise(
      to_mkm = sum(mkm),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  gains <- transition_summary |>
    filter(changed) |>
    group_by(
      comparison_id,
      comparison_label,
      class = to_class
    ) |>
    summarise(
      gain_mkm = sum(mkm),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  losses <- transition_summary |>
    filter(changed) |>
    group_by(
      comparison_id,
      comparison_label,
      class = from_class
    ) |>
    summarise(
      loss_mkm = sum(mkm),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  full_join(
    from_summary,
    to_summary,
    by = c(
      "comparison_id",
      "comparison_label",
      "class"
    )
  ) |>
    full_join(
      gains,
      by = c(
        "comparison_id",
        "comparison_label",
        "class"
      )
    ) |>
    full_join(
      losses,
      by = c(
        "comparison_id",
        "comparison_label",
        "class"
      )
    ) |>
    complete(
      nesting(
        comparison_id,
        comparison_label
      ),
      class = class_levels
    ) |>
    mutate(
      across(
        c(
          from_mkm,
          to_mkm,
          gain_mkm,
          loss_mkm
        ),
        ~ replace_na(.x, 0)
      ),
      total_land_area = sum(from_mkm, na.rm = TRUE),
      from_pct = from_mkm / total_land_area,
      to_pct = to_mkm / total_land_area,
      gain_pct = gain_mkm / total_land_area,
      loss_pct = loss_mkm / total_land_area,
      net_pct = (to_mkm - from_mkm) / total_land_area,
      comparison_label = factor(
        comparison_label,
        levels = comparison_levels
      ),
      class = factor(
        class,
        levels = class_levels
      ),
      .by = c(
        comparison_id,
        comparison_label
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(
      comparison_label,
      class
    )
}

# build a transition matrices
fn_build_transition_matrix_gt <- function(
  transition_summary,
  comparison,
  class_levels,
  title,
  hide_diagonal = TRUE
) {
  matrix_df <- transition_summary |>
    filter(
      comparison_label ==
        comparison
    ) |>
    select(
      from_class,
      to_class,
      pct
    ) |>
    complete(
      from_class = class_levels,
      to_class = class_levels,
      fill = list(
        pct = 0
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      from_class = factor(
        from_class,
        levels = class_levels
      ),
      to_class = factor(
        to_class,
        levels = class_levels
      ),
      pct = if_else(
        hide_diagonal &
          as.character(from_class) ==
            as.character(to_class),
        NA_real_,
        pct
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(
      from_class,
      to_class
    ) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = to_class,
      values_from = pct
    )

  matrix_df |>
    gt(
      rowname_col = "from_class"
    ) |>
    tab_header(
      title = title,
      subtitle = paste(
        comparison,
        "— percent of global land area"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_stubhead(
      label = "From"
    ) |>
    tab_spanner(
      label = "To",
      columns = all_of(
        class_levels
      )
    ) |>
    fmt_percent(
      columns = all_of(
        class_levels
      ),
      decimals = 2
    ) |>
    sub_missing(
      columns = all_of(
        class_levels
      ),
      missing_text = "—"
    )
}

# Largest Climate Type Transitions
fn_largest_transitions_gt <- function(
  transition_summary,
  title,
  n = 12
) {
  transition_summary |>
    filter(changed) |>
    group_by(
      comparison_id,
      comparison_label
    ) |>
    slice_max(
      order_by = mkm,
      n = n,
      with_ties = FALSE
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      transition = paste(
        from_class,
        "→",
        to_class
      )
    ) |>
    select(
      comparison_label,
      transition,
      mkm,
      pct
    ) |>
    arrange(
      comparison_label,
      desc(mkm)
    ) |>
    gt(groupname_col = "comparison_label") |>
    tab_header(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "Largest changed classifications by land area"
    ) |>
    cols_label(
      transition = "Transition",
      mkm = "Area (Mkm²)",
      pct = "Land Area %"
    ) |>
    fmt_number(
      columns = mkm,
      decimals = 2
    ) |>
    fmt_percent(
      columns = pct,
      decimals = 2
    )
}

# 
fn_build_net_change_plot <- function(
  net_change_df,
  title,
  x_label
) {
  plot_df <- net_change_df |>
    left_join(
      transition_comparisons |>
        select(
          comparison_id,
          from_period_id,
          to_period_id
        ),
      by = "comparison_id"
    ) |>
    left_join(
      climate_periods |>
        select(
          period_id,
          from_abbr = period_abbr
        ),
      by = c(
        "from_period_id" = "period_id"
      )
    ) |>
    left_join(
      climate_periods |>
        select(
          period_id,
          to_abbr = period_abbr
        ),
      by = c(
        "to_period_id" = "period_id"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      bar_period = if_else(
        net_pct >= 0,
        to_abbr,
        from_abbr
      ),
      bar_period = factor(
        bar_period,
        levels = climate_periods$period_abbr
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = class,
      y = net_pct,
      fill = bar_period
    )
  ) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      vars(comparison_label),
      ncol = 1
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format(
        accuracy = 0.1
      )
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = period_palette,
      breaks = climate_periods$period_abbr,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = x_label,
      y = "Global Land Area %",
      fill = "Climate Interval"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(
      base_size = 12
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )
}

fn_build_net_change_gt <- function(
  net_change_df,
  title,
  stub_header
) {
  display_df <- net_change_df |>
    transmute(
      class = as.character(class),
      comparison_id,
      gain_pct,
      loss_pct,
      net_pct
    ) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = comparison_id,
      values_from = c(
        gain_pct,
        loss_pct,
        net_pct
      ),
      names_glue = "{comparison_id}_{.value}"
    )

  display_df |>
    gt(
      rowname_col = "class"
    ) |>
    tab_header(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "Percentage of global land area"
    ) |>
    tab_stubhead(
      label = stub_header
    ) |>

    tab_spanner(
      label = "REF → CSN",
      columns = c(
        ref_csn_gain_pct,
        ref_csn_loss_pct,
        ref_csn_net_pct
      )
    ) |>
    tab_spanner(
      label = "CSN → RCI",
      columns = c(
        csn_rci_gain_pct,
        csn_rci_loss_pct,
        csn_rci_net_pct
      )
    ) |>
    tab_spanner(
      label = "REF → RCI",
      columns = c(
        ref_rci_gain_pct,
        ref_rci_loss_pct,
        ref_rci_net_pct
      )
    ) |>

    cols_label(
      ref_csn_gain_pct = "Gain",
      ref_csn_loss_pct = "Loss",
      ref_csn_net_pct = "Net",
      csn_rci_gain_pct = "Gain",
      csn_rci_loss_pct = "Loss",
      csn_rci_net_pct = "Net",
      ref_rci_gain_pct = "Gain",
      ref_rci_loss_pct = "Loss",
      ref_rci_net_pct = "Net"
    ) |>

    fmt_percent(
      columns = ends_with("_pct"),
      decimals = 2
    ) |>

    cols_align(
      align = "right",
      columns = ends_with("_pct")
    )
}

```

## Main Process

```{r}
#| label: main-process
#| results: hide

if (run_transition_analysis) {
  if (!file_exists(classification_path)) {
    stop(
      "The classification dataset does not exist. ",
      "Run 02-climate-classification.qmd first."
    )
  }

  classification_results <- read_parquet(
    classification_path
  )

  transition_results <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      seq_len(nrow(transition_comparisons)),
      function(i) {
        fn_build_transition(
          classification_results,
          transition_comparisons[i, ]
        )
      }
    )
  )

  write_parquet(
    transition_results,
    transitions_path
  )
} else {
  if (!file_exists(transitions_path)) {
    stop(
      "The transition dataset does not exist. ",
      "Set run_transition_analysis <- TRUE and run the notebook once."
    )
  }

  transition_results <- read_parquet(
    transitions_path
  )
}

change_overview <- fn_change_overview(
  transition_results
)

group_transitions <- fn_transition_summary(
  transition_results,
  "from_grp",
  "to_grp"
)

type_transitions <- fn_transition_summary(
  transition_results,
  "from_ktc",
  "to_ktc"
)

group_net_change <- fn_net_change(
  group_transitions,
  group_levels
)

type_net_change <- fn_net_change(
  type_transitions,
  ktc_levels
)
```

## Overall Classification Change

This summary shows the percentage of global land area whose Köppen–Trewartha classification changes in each pairwise comparison. A type change may occur within the same broad climate group, so type-change percentages can exceed group-change percentages.

```{r}
#| label: change-overview-table
#| echo: false

change_overview |>
  transmute(
    `Comparison` = as.character(comparison_label),
    `Group Change Area (Mkm²)` = group_changed_area,
    `Group Change` = group_changed_pct,
    `Type Change Area (Mkm²)` = type_changed_area,
    `Type Change` = type_changed_pct
  ) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "KTC Classification Change Summary"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(
      `Group Change Area (Mkm²)`,
      `Type Change Area (Mkm²)`
    ),
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  fmt_percent(
    columns = c(
      `Group Change`,
      `Type Change`
    ),
    decimals = 2
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: change-overview-plot
#| fig-height: 4
#| out-width: 100%

change_overview |>
  select(
    comparison_label,
    group_changed_pct,
    type_changed_pct
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      group_changed_pct,
      type_changed_pct
    ),
    names_to = "classification_level",
    values_to = "pct"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    classification_level = recode(
      classification_level,
      group_changed_pct = "Climate Group",
      type_changed_pct = "Climate Type"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = comparison_label,
      y = pct,
      fill = classification_level
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Land Area with Changed KTC Classification",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Global Land Area %",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
```

## Climate Group Transitions

The matrices show the share of global land area assigned to each origin and destination climate group. Diagonal cells represent unchanged group assignments; off-diagonal cells represent group transitions.

```{r}
#| label: group-transition-matrices
#| echo: false

fn_build_transition_matrix_gt(
  group_transitions,
  "REF → CSN",
  group_levels,
  "KTC Group Transition Matrix"
)

fn_build_transition_matrix_gt(
  group_transitions,
  "CSN → RCI",
  group_levels,
  "KTC Group Transition Matrix"
)

fn_build_transition_matrix_gt(
  group_transitions,
  "REF → RCI",
  group_levels,
  "KTC Group Transition Matrix"
)
```

## Net Group Change

Net change is the difference between the destination and origin land area assigned to each climate group. Gains and losses summarize only land that changed classification.
